rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 19 international datasets with 37 dMRI acquisition protocols from multiple countries (United States, The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Cuba, China, Australia, India)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Here we present the first large-scale normative model of brain WM microstructure based on 19 international diffusion MRI datasets covering almost the entire lifespan (totaling N=54,583 individuals; age: 4-91 years)." ; "We identified 37 dMRI acquisition protocols across the 19 datasets"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Multiple EPDs used for normative model training, including ABCD, HCP (HCP-YA, HCP-A, HCP-D), Cam-CAN, UK Biobank, PNC, OASIS3, ADNI3, HBN
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We included the following public datasets with various age ranges to cover the lifespan: the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD)... the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (CAMCAN)... the Human Connectome Project Aging & Development (HCP_A & HCP_D)... the Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP_YA)... the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC)... and the UK BioBank (UKBB)." ; "the third phase of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI3)... the third release of the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS3)... and the Healthy Brain Network (HBN)"

rci3_epd_name.answer: ABCD; HCP; Cam-CAN; UK Biobank; PNC; OASIS; ADNI; HBN
rci3_epd_name.detail: ABCD (population-based); HCP-YA, HCP-A, HCP-D (all three HCP sub-studies used); Cam-CAN (CAMCAN, population-based); UK Biobank (UKBB, population-based); PNC (population-based); OASIS3 (controls only); ADNI3 (controls only); HBN (controls only)
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We included the following public datasets... the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD)... the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (CAMCAN)... the Human Connectome Project Aging & Development (HCP_A & HCP_D)... the Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP_YA)... the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC)... and the UK BioBank (UKBB)." ; "the third phase of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI3)... the third release of the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS3)... and the Healthy Brain Network (HBN)... only the healthy controls (HC) of the latter four datasets were added to the pool of training data to build the normative models, yielding a total of 19 public datasets."

rci7_age.detail: Overall phase; age range 4-91 years as stated in abstract. Table 2 reports Median Age (SD) per dataset, not mean. Weighted mean approximated using per-dataset medians as proxy for means. Pooled SD includes both within-dataset and between-dataset variance. Per-dataset Table 2 age ranges span 3-95, but abstract explicitly states 4-91 for the reference cohort; age in years.
